remarks: NEWLY RENOVATED Ranch-Style Condo in a Desirable Norwalk Location. The entire condo complex has just completed installing Brand NEW Roofing and All NEW Siding. Welcome to this beautiful ground level unit both inside and out, just minutes from The SoNo Collection, renowned restaurants, museums, shopping, beaches, and a thriving community garden. A perfect blend of lifestyle and convenience with an easy  one-hour commute to NYC. The property is just minutes to both the Rowayton and South Norwalk Metro-North train stations and highway entrances. Once you are inside of this unit, you'll find an impressive modern kitchen outfitted with a waterfall countertop, matching backsplash, coordinating stainless steel appliances, and ample outlets/storage/countertop space. The open-concept dining and living area flow effortlessly to double glass sliders, letting in beautiful natural light and revealing a designated patio space ideal for entertaining or relaxing at home. The additional convenient features including with this unit are as follows: a RESERVED parking space (#D1), ample VISITOR Parking alongside the fence, secure dedicated storage space in the storage room, IN-UNIT Washer & Dryer. Move in ready for a first-time home owner or someone downsizing. This condo is a must-see!
